title: java debugging / Install
content: ## Install To get the complete Java language support in {% data variables.product.prodname_vscode %}, you can install the [Extension Pack for Java](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=vscjava.vscode-java-pack), which includes the Debugger for Java extension. Install the Extension Pack for Java >For details on how to get started with the extension pack, you can review the [Getting Started with Java](/docs/java/java-tutorial.md) tutorial.
